description:
Figure 8, titled "S_r ratio ablation study," is a line plot that illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio (S_r) and two performance metrics: perplexity and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis, labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with major tick marks at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left, labeled "Perplexity," is a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with major tick marks at intervals of 10.

The plot contains three distinct lines:
- The "Perplexity" line, represented by an orange line with circular markers, shows a general downward trend as the recent sequence ratio increases. It starts at a perplexity of approximately 4.6 at a ratio of 0% and decreases to about 4.35 at a ratio of 100%.
- The "Full Cache PPL" line, represented by a red dashed line, is a horizontal line at a constant perplexity of 4.35 across the entire range of the x-axis.
- The "GPU Mem. Ratio" line, represented by a blue line with circular markers, shows a sharp increase in GPU memory ratio as the recent sequence ratio increases. It starts at a ratio of approximately 40% at a ratio of 0% and rises steeply to 100% at a ratio of 100%. The "Full Cache GPU Mem." line, represented by a blue dashed line, is a horizontal line at a constant ratio of 100% across the entire range of the x-axis.
